headers.subject: Saltmarsh Analytics: complete your coding assessment

snippet: Hi Mateo, as part of your application for Data Engineer at Saltmarsh Analytics, please complete the coding assessment within 5 days.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

As part of your application for Data Engineer at Saltmarsh Analytics, please complete the 90 minute coding assessment by Wednesday 7 October at 23:59 Monterrey time (UTC-6).

Start the assessment: https://tests.codebench.example/s/ZT44-91LK

Job posting: https://apply.workable.com/saltmarsh-analytics/j/7C3A91F0B2

Saltmarsh Analytics Hiring Team

extraction.summary: Saltmarsh Analytics sent a coding assessment due 7 October.
